name: coordinator-single-item-dispatch
body:
The coordinator dispatches exactly one feedback item per writer invocation. It selects a single Feedback item (status `open`), gives one writer that item (its FQN and body), and that writer fixes or explores only that item and returns a claim of ACTIONED (with the change) or WONT-FIX (with justification). The coordinator must never batch multiple feedback items into one writer dispatch, and the writer's response is the claim alone — the writer does not action the item.

Acceptance: one dispatch carries exactly one feedback FQN; a writer handed one item returns one claim; the coordinator never issues a dispatch covering two or more open items.
